Public audit fixture <![CDATA[LangSmith experiencing downtime due to Postgres saturation]]> https://global.status.smith.langchain.com/gcp-us/incidents/01M850K8N45Y9A6ZD8GEC76BFC https://global.status.smith.langchain.com/gcp-us/incidents/01M850K8N45Y9A6ZD8GEC76BFC Mon, 23 Nov 2026 20:31:47 GMT Status: Monitoring

We have diagnosed the issue and implemented some controls to prevent runaway queries. All systems are back online and continuing to monitor.

Affected components
  • LangSmith Bulk Exports (Operational)
  • LangSmith Deployments Control Plane (Operational)
  • LangSmith Billing (Operational)
  • LangSmith Run Ingestion (Operational)
  • LangSmith Sandboxes (Operational)
  • LangSmith Fleet (Operational)
  • LangSmith Application (Operational)
  • LangSmith PromptHub (Operational)
  • LangSmith API (Operational)
  • LangSmith Deployments Data Plane (Operational)
  • LangSmith LLM Gateway (Operational)
